title: Aoyagi Toya — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And then, just when I was about to get my chance to drink a really special cup of coffee made with the new beans...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The time you'd agreed upon with Rin and Len came around, I take it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Exactly! I asked them to wait just ten minutes, or ideally half an hour, but...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Ten minutes would be one thing, but of course they wouldn't want to wait for thirty.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, those two took him away, and MEIKO and I had that yummy coffee all to ourselves.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You could have brought some over for us...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh well, it's no biggie. I'll just make more some other time. And when I do, I hope you'll try it, Toya.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Of course! We're fellow coffee lovers, aren't we? Besides, isn't your birthday coming up?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that's totally right! Hey, Toya, are you gonna party with your friends and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito and the others have said they'll do something to celebrate, but other than that, I—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, go ahead and take that. We'll stay quiet.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Gah! Stand back, Saki. I'm the one who's calling!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <That's not how it works! You called, so I get to talk first♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Yes, sorry to startle you. Do you have a moment?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Great! Okay so, your birthday's next week, right? We—>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <We want to hold a birthday party for you at our home, much like the one we had for White Day in the past!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Wait, Tsukasa! I was about to tell him!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <So Toya, do you already have plans in place for your birthday?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <I have a combination practice session and birthday party with Akito and the others, but I'm open in the afternoon.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Really?! Then, could you come to our place?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <Of course. I would love to pay a visit.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Indeed I did! Well, we'll be preparing to put on a phenomenal show upon your arrival!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Hey! Tsukasa, I was just telling you how we should change things up a little this time. We always put on a show!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Perish the thought. It's the tradition that makes it ideal. I'm sure you'd agree, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <I'm just happy to know you two will be celebrating my birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Yes, of course!
See, what did I say?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <He's just saying that 'cause he's nice. His birthday is a really special occasion, so we've gotta celebrate it like one.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Fine, I give! If you're so intent on the idea, then why don't we have ourselves a battle to see who can make the day more fun for him?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Fine by me! There's NO way I'm gonna lose! Look forward to it, Toya♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <With that decided, I need to begin my preparations immediately! Alright, Toya, I'll get back to you later with a meeting time!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hahaha! They're gonna have a battle to see who can make his birthday more fun. That should be interesting!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yeah, for real! You could just tell how much they care.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You must be excited for your birthday, Toya♪>
A few days later - Lunch break

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Akito and Mizuki are with you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why are you surprised I'm here? I'm his classmate.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh-huh, try saying that again once you actually start showing up every day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, what brings you here?
And with Kusanagi in tow...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What am I gonna do? I have this awful feeling I'm gonna get called on in math today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same here. I haven't been called on at all lately, so it's about—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Nene, Shiraishi, I've found you! Please, lend me your wisdom!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For some reason, he asked us all this stuff about how to make a birthday show you'd enjoy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He talked to you guys too, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, did he also ask you two?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Apparently he and Saki are having a battle to see who can make Toya's birthday more fun♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, Saki had already reached out to me, so all Tsukasa got from me was an apology.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um...
It's not my place to ask, but is this bothering you at all?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I know Tsukasa is doing his utmost to make my birthday enjoyable. I can hardly wait for the day to come.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, none of you have mentioned what you told Tsukasa and Saki.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're not about to tell you that. It might end up spoiling something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see, so this was in my best interest. I apologize for not putting that together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can't be sure. He might actually be trying to get off the hook for whatever gets chosen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Could it be? Did you give Tsukasa a half-baked response and put your partner's special day in danger?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What was that?
You can bet I helped as best I could...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you all.
I'll be looking forward to the day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You do that♪ Make sure you get all that birthday love!
